description:
Update field values on a Digital Product Passport. Every change is audit-logged with the credential (API key or connected app) and this MCP channel.

`source` (optional): omit it or pass "manual" when the user gave you the value or it comes from their own records — written with the user's rights (approved for an API key or an admin; sent to review for a connected app acting for an editor). Pass "ai_suggested" when you found or inferred it yourself: it goes to the dashboard review queue for a human, and is refused on fields only the operator may state or that must be measured (e.g. stateOfHealth).

Actions (pass via `action`; `{…}` is the `args` object):
- update — { id, fieldKey, value, source? }. `value` type matches the field's dataType.
- update_by_serial — { serial, fieldKey, value, gtin?, source? }. On 409 ambiguous_serial (a serial is unique only WITHIN a GTIN) pass `gtin`.
name: tracepass_passport_fields
title: TracePass passport fields
